texts.value: Serine hydrolase (Probable) (PubMed:32196348). Catalyzes the hydrolytic activation of amino acid ester of the antiviral prodrug valacyclovir to its corresponding active drug, acyclovir (PubMed:32196348). May negatively regulate basal or autocrine TGF-beta signaling by suppressing SMAD2-SMAD3 phosphorylation (PubMed:20080647). May play a role in the transformation process due to its capacity to confer resistance to the growth-inhibitory effects of TGF-beta through interaction with RB1 and the subsequent displacement of E2F1 (PubMed:9697699)
Inhibited by the natural product emetine produced by the ipecac root
kcat is 193 sec(-1) with valacyclovir as substrate.
Interacts with RB1; the interaction disrupts RB1 binding to E2F1 (PubMed:21689726). Interacts with RBL1 and RBL2 (By similarity)
Expressed at higher levels in tumor tissues such as carcinoma
Plays a role in maintaining pluripotency in human stem cells in vitro

features.description: Loss of serine hydrolase activity. Fails to block TGF-beta-mediated anti-proliferative signal in tumor cells.
